description: Linux kernel GPIO driver for NCT5104D Super-I/O chip, including register access functions, GPIO bank management, and platform driver initialization.

methods.name: superio_inb
methods.description: Reads a byte from the Super-I/O register at specified base and register.

methods.name: superio_inw
methods.description: Reads a word (2 bytes) from the Super-I/O register at specified base and register.

methods.name: superio_outb
methods.description: Writes a byte to the Super-I/O register at specified base and register.

methods.name: superio_enter
methods.description: Enters Super-I/O configuration mode at specified base address.

methods.name: superio_select
methods.description: Selects a logical device within Super-I/O at specified base address.

methods.name: superio_exit
methods.description: Exits Super-I/O configuration mode at specified base address.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_probe
methods.description: Probes and initializes GPIO banks for the NCT5104D chip.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_remove
methods.description: Removes GPIO chip instances during driver cleanup.

methods.name: nct5104d_find
methods.description: Detects the NCT5104D chip at a given I/O address and initializes its data structure.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_device_add
methods.description: Creates and registers platform device for the GPIO driver.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO driver, registers platform driver, and detects device.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_exit
methods.description: Cleans up and unregisters platform device and driver.
